headword: {有効求人倍率|ゆうこうきゅうじんばいりつ}
reading: ゆうこうきゅうじんばいりつ
gloss: ratio of job openings to job seekers

definitions.gloss: ratio of job openings to job seekers; jobs-to-applicants ratio
definitions.explanation: An official measure of the job market: the number of open positions divided by the number of people looking for work, as registered at public employment offices.

examples.japanese: {有効求人倍率|ゆうこうきゅうじんばいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{上|あ}がった→上がる：00615_agaru⟧。
⟦{先月|せんげつ}→先月：00751_sengetsu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{有効求人倍率|ゆうこうきゅうじんばいりつ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1.2⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧だった。

{有効求人倍率|ゆうこうきゅうじんばいりつ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧1⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{超|こ}える→超える：01942_koeru⟧⟦と→と：00512_to⟧、⟦{仕事|しごと}→仕事：00480_shigoto⟧⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{探|さが}す→探す：00493_sagasu⟧⟦{人|ひと}→人：00476_hito⟧⟦より→より：09476_yori⟧⟦{求人|きゅうじん}→求人：04690_kyuujin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧ほう⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧こと⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{意味|いみ}→意味：01155_imi⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: When the jobs-to-applicants ratio is above 1, it means there are more job openings than job seekers.

notes:
USAGE:
Published monthly by the Ministry of Health, Labour and Welfare from the figures of the public employment offices (⟦ハローワーク→ハローワーク：28059_haroowaaku⟧), and widely reported as a sign of the economy. A value is given with ⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧: 1.2⟦{倍|ばい}→倍：01492_bai⟧.
